---
title: Theme
---

This page's planted failure lives in the **Quarto dark theme**, not in a
`prefers-color-scheme` media query — which is the distinction that matters.

Quarto ignores `prefers-color-scheme` unless `respect-user-color-scheme` is set,
so emulating a dark preference does not select the dark theme. The only route in
is Quarto's own colour-scheme toggle. Before the scanner drove that toggle, this
failure was invisible: the dark cells rendered the light theme.

```{=html}
<style>
/* PLANTED: color-contrast (serious), Quarto dark theme only.
   #6c757d on darkly's #222 is about 3.5:1. The same colour on the light
   theme's white passes, so the finding appears only once the dark theme is
   actually selected. Keep this paragraph free of links and inline code, whose
   own colours would add unplanned findings. */
.axe-fixture-theme-only { color: #6c757d; }
</style>
```

{{< include _systemic.qmd >}}

::: {.axe-fixture-theme-only}
This paragraph fails colour contrast only when Quarto's dark theme is selected.
:::
